title: Leveraging Swin Transformer for advanced sentiment analysis: a new paradigm

sections.text:

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】As healthcare text data becomes increasingly complex, it is vital for sentiment analysis to capture local patterns and global contextual dependencies.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:

【Abstract · abstract-1-7】We will examine future research directions into exploring lightweight attention mechanisms, cross-domain multimodal sentiment analysis, federated learning to protect privacy, and hardware implications for rapid training and inference.

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《Leveraging Swin Transformer for advanced sentiment analysis: a new paradigm》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-4】Our findings show that the Swin-MLP model performs significantly better overall, achieving superior metrics (accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, and AUC) and improving mean accuracy by 1-2% over BERT.
